import os

# The sandbox limits process/thread counts; keep Polars' thread pool minimal.
# Must be set before polars is imported.
os.environ["POLARS_MAX_THREADS"] = "1"

import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "product": ["Laptop", "Mouse", "Keyboard", "Monitor", "Desk", "Chair", "Notebook"],
    "category": ["Electronics", "Electronics", "Electronics", "Electronics", "Furniture", "Furniture", "Stationery"],
    "price": [999.99, 15.5, 45.0, 199.99, 250.0, 120.5, 4.25],
})

result = (
    df.lazy()
    .filter(pl.col("price") > 20)
    .group_by("category")
    .agg(pl.col("price").mean().alias("avg_price"))
    .sort("category")
    .collect()
)

print(result)
